change.description: Prevent Product Release input freezing from timing out on large public media snapshots by using bounded release-only download parallelism and a matching workflow timeout contract, with a verified recovery path for cancelled runs before frozen artifacts exist.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: This is a backward-compatible release orchestration fix. It changes only release-time worker bounds and the job timeout; public endpoints, application data, and persistent formats remain unchanged.

current.reasoning: Product Release now passes an explicit concurrency of 8 to the public media freezer, validates the bound in the release input layer, and extends only the signed production release timeout to 360 minutes; content deployment remains at one worker. A separate recovery workflow can abandon only a cancelled merged run with no frozen artifacts after revalidating its run identity.

scope_drift.description: The candidate is limited to release input freezing, workflow contract validation, runbook guidance, and focused regression coverage.
